comparisons.title: McNuggets vs Chick-fil-A Nuggets
comparisons.note: Chick-fil-A sells nuggets in 8 and 12 counts and McDonald's in 4, 6, 10 and 20, so this compares the closest sizes: 10 McNuggets against 12 Chick-fil-A nuggets.

comparisons.title: McDonald's Fries vs Burger King Fries
McDonald's Fries vs Chick-fil-A Waffle Fries
Domino's vs Pizza Hut Pepperoni Pizza
comparisons.note: Domino's publishes values for a slice of a large (14") pizza and Pizza Hut for a slice of a medium (12") pizza, so a Domino's slice is bigger. Compare whole orders in each calculator if you are choosing a pizza to share.

comparisons.title: KFC Original Recipe vs Extra Crispy
McFlurry vs Blizzard
comparisons.note: Both are the OREO version: a regular McFlurry against a small Blizzard.

vegetarian_notes.mcdonalds: In the U.S., McDonald's fries and hash browns contain natural beef flavor, so they are not vegetarian. None of the main items in our McDonald's data is meat-free.
vegetarian_notes.kfc: KFC's gravy, green beans and BBQ baked beans are left out because they may contain meat or meat flavoring.
vegetarian_notes.chipotle: Build a bowl or burrito from sofritas, rice, beans, salsas, cheese and guacamole; every part is in the Chipotle calculator.
vegetarian_notes.burger-king: The Impossible Whopper is not in our Burger King data yet, so only sides and desserts are listed.
vegetarian_notes.panda-express: Panda Express cooks in shared woks, so vegetarian sides may touch meat dishes.
